intro.heading: ABOUT THE MAHAYAGNAM
intro.tagline: A Grand Vedic Resolve for Lokakalyanam
intro.description: The Srikari Ati Rudra Mahayagnam brings together Sri Rudram, Nakshatra Shanthi and special Vedic rituals in a 28-day observance. Devotees may participate on their Janma Nakshatra day with Sankalpam in their name and Gotram. The Mahayagnam is offered with prayers for peace, health, family harmony, prosperity, protection of Dharma, preservation of Vedic traditions and the welfare of all creation.
intro.quote: “Not just a Yagnam, but a prayer for the world.”

sriRudram.heading: WHAT IS SRI RUDRAM?
sriRudram.description: Sri Rudram is a revered Vedic prayer dedicated to Lord Shiva and is traditionally recited as part of Vedic worship. Embedded in the Krishna Yajur Veda, it celebrates the all-pervading omnipresence, supreme benevolence, and cosmic protection of Lord Parameshwara.
sriRudram.significance: Comprising the sacred Namakam and Chamakam, Sri Rudram invokes divine blessings for peace, auspiciousness, and spiritual illumination.

ekadasaRudram.heading: WHAT IS EKADASA RUDRAM?
ekadasaRudram.description: Ekadasa Rudram is the traditional chanting of Sri Rudram 11 times by 11 consecrated Vedic Ritwiks, invoking the 11 divine aspects of Lord Shiva known as the Ekadasa Rudras.
ekadasaRudram.explanation: When Sri Rudram is chanted 11 times, it forms an Ekadasa Rudram. When repeated progressively across sacred cycles, it ascends to Maha Rudram and culminates in the supreme Ati Rudram.

atiRudram.heading: WHAT IS ATI RUDRAM?
atiRudram.description: Ati Rudram is regarded as the highest pinnacle of Vedic worship dedicated to Lord Shiva. It represents the magnificent completion of 14,641 recitations of Sri Rudram by 121 devout Vedic scholars accompanied by continuous sacred Havis offerings into 11 Homa Kundas over 28 auspicious days (25 Nov to 22 Dec 2026, Rohini to Rohini).

rudrabhishekam.heading: SIGNIFICANCE OF RUDRABHISHEKAM
rudrabhishekam.description: Rudrabhishekam is the sacred devotional practice of offering holy dravyas—such as milk, honey, tender coconut water, and sacred bhasma—to the Shiva Lingam while chanting the Sri Rudram. It is the most direct and cherished form of worship to invoke the supreme grace and peace of Lord Shiva.

nakshatras.heading: SIGNIFICANCE OF THE NAKSHATRAS
nakshatras.description: The Srikari Ati Rudra Mahayagnam includes a unique 28-day programme organized around the Vedic Nakshatra schedule (Rohini to Rohini). Each day honors a specific birth star with specialized Vedic homams and deity invocations.

nakshatraShanthi.heading: WHAT IS NAKSHATRA SHANTHI?
nakshatraShanthi.headline: PERFORM NAKSHATRA SHANTHI ON YOUR JANMA NAKSHATRA
nakshatraShanthi.description: Nakshatra Shanthi is a traditional remedial and protective Vedic homam conducted to harmonize birth-star planetary influences, remove persistent obstacles, and bestow peace, health, and family prosperity.

lokakalyana.heading: LOKAKALYANAHITA SRIKARI ATI RUDRA MAHAYAGNAM
lokakalyana.description: The Mahayagnam is presented as a devotional offering with the intention of Lokakalyana—universal harmony, family peace, health, prosperity, protection of Dharma, environmental nourishment, and spiritual upliftment of all beings.
